description:
About our brand and products:
Duri Cosmetics is a family-owned nail care brand built on a treatment-first philosophy. For over 30 years, we’ve focused on creating high-performance formulas designed to support natural nail health—because beautiful color starts with strong nails. Our assortment spans targeted nail treatments like Rejuvacote 1 (Maximum Strength) and Rejuvacote 2 (Balanced Repair), along with professional-quality top coats, quick-dry solutions, and long-wear nail colors. All products are made in the USA and developed with a formula-first approach rooted in salon heritage.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn competitive commission on every sale generated through their unique links (20% commission via UpPromote). With strong repeat purchase behavior, especially from hero products like Rejuvacote—there’s meaningful opportunity for recurring earnings. We also support affiliates with exclusive offers, bundles, and seasonal promotions to help maximize conversion.

How to promote us:
Our products perform best when positioned as part of a nail care routine, not just a single purchase. Content that educates and demonstrates results tends to convert strongest. Effective angles include:

  • Nail transformation journeys (before/after, growth progress)
  • “Healthy nails first” messaging
  • Routine-based content (base coat → color → top coat systems)
  • Busy lifestyle beauty (low-maintenance, long-lasting manicures)
  • Comparisons: weak nails vs. polished, healthy nails

We work well across beauty, lifestyle, and wellness creators—especially those speaking to women 35+ looking for simple, effective ways to maintain natural nails.

The Duri Difference:

  • Family-owned, independently operated brand
  • Made in the USA
  • Established salon heritage with a loyal customer base
  • High repeat purchase rates driven by performance-focused formulas
  • Dedicated affiliate support and creative collaboration opportunities
